asr.quality_boundary: Automatic ASR contains clear corruptions and merged speaker turns; the package uses bounded event summaries and prohibits verbatim quotation without original-audio review.

visual.finding: The Short shows a first grey-top participant continuing away, then an interaction with a red-haired/white-top woman and a dark-top/white-skirt woman. Phone handling is visible but no readable screen, confirmed contact save, attraction, filming/publication consent or later outcome is shown. Identifiable participants, bystanders and the public WeChat handle remain privacy-sensitive.

formal_comparator.visual_review_scope: 21-frame full sparse survey plus three documented 1fps key windows totaling 70 frames; preserved survey image independently inspected
formal_comparator.reason: The formal source shows different beige/striped participants, a white-shirt red-armband third party, different storefront framing, refusal/model/coffee dialogue and a promotional hard cut. The Short instead shows a grey-top departure, a different two-woman group, shopping/local-origin/Jiangsu-Wuxi/tourism/next-day-departure dialogue and different street details. A black ESSENTIALS shirt and broad street setting are not sufficient identity evidence.

dedup.boundary: New means only a distinct research case in the processed corpus. It does not validate the title's lesson, prove successful contact exchange or authenticate the field man as Mikey.

open_restrictions_preserved: The first woman's exact reply is not reliably transcribed; clear refusal or continued departure remains a stop signal and the observed switch is not permission to persist.
Phone handling does not prove a voluntary contact exchange, saved contact, attraction or later meeting.
The field man self-identifies as Mike, but the Short does not independently authenticate him as Mikey; unclear participant and third-party turns remain unattributed.
Participant adulthood, filming consent and publication authorization are not established.
The appearance-based 'small' comment is not guidance and cannot support an age inference.

fixes.resolution: Changed the item to a distinct new research case with no reuse parent and formal_weight_if_integrated=1; replaced the false same-recording evidence with the transcript and visual differences; changed both claims from reuse_zero_weight to candidate_new_case; rewrote the duplicate review item as a parent-identity warning. Formal integration and all generation permissions remain closed.
fixes.final_consistency_fix: Removed two residual same-recording statements from content-dedup evidence[0] and distillation visual_findings[1]; both now state that no exact identity or parent recording is confirmed and that the Short is a distinct case.
